name: deva
lore:
Imagine the celestial realms, shimmering with divine light, where beings of pure goodness dwell. Among these are the Devas, angelic warriors and messengers of the gods. With magnificent feathered wings, they soar through the Upper Planes, their forms radiating an otherworldly beauty. Each Deva is a beacon of hope, a testament to the unwavering power of good against the encroaching darkness.

There are Astral Devas, golden-hued guardians who venture into the Lower Planes to battle fiends and rescue lost souls. Monadic Devas, with their dark skin and piercing green eyes, watch over the Elemental Planes and the Ethereal Plane, ensuring balance and harmony. And then there are the Movanic Devas, milky-skinned angels who walk among mortals on the Prime Material Plane, disguised as ordinary beings, offering aid and inspiration to those in need. They are the silent protectors, the guiding lights in the darkest of times.

These celestial beings, though powerful, are not without their purpose. They serve as the hands of the gods, carrying out their divine will with unwavering dedication. Whether battling demons, guiding mortals, or watching over the elements, the Devas stand as a symbol of hope, a promise that even in the face of overwhelming darkness, the light of goodness will never be extinguished.
